# Register a diagnostic plot

<small>Source: [`R/diagnosticsRegistry.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/diagnosticsRegistry.R) · Help: `?registerPlot`</small>

Register a diagnostic plot

## Usage

```r
registerPlot(name, fun)
```

## Arguments

`name`
:   Name of the plot

`fun`
:   Function taking a model and returning a ggplot object

## Value

Invisibly returns `NULL`.

## Examples

```r
registerPlot("custom_plot", function(model) ggplot2::ggplot())
```
